claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Paris (Br.), Kennedy, Liverpool July 11, via
Queenstown 12th, with mdse. and pass to John G. Dale. July 11,
passed steamships Kangaroo and City of New-York, hence for Liver-
pool; 12th, off Tuskar, steamship The Queen, hence for Liverpool;
17th, lat. 49, long. 45 15, passed a large iceberg; 19th, lat. 42 10, long.
61, ship Orient, bound E; 20th, 420 miles E of Sandy Hook, steam-
ship Aleppo, hence for Liverpool; same day, 290 miles E of Sandy
Hook, steamship St. Mark, bound W.
